14	#pragma once
15	
16	#include <iostream>
17	#include <memory>
18	#include <mutex>
19	#include <string>
20	#include <vector>
21	#include <arrow/compute/api.h>
22	#include <arrow/table_builder.h>
23	#include <arrow/util/async_generator.h>
24	#include <zvec/db/doc.h>
25	#include <zvec/db/status.h>

27	#include "chunked_file_writer.h"
28	#include "store_helper.h"
29	
30	namespace zvec {
31	
32	/// MemForwardStore implements a forward store that keeps data in memory
33	/// and can flush data to disk when needed.
34	class MemForwardStore : public BaseForwardStore {
35	 public:
36	  /// Pointer type for MemForwardStore instances
37	  using Ptr = std::shared_ptr<MemForwardStore>;
38	
39	  /// Constructor that initializes the store with collection schema and settings
40	  /// \param collection_schema The schema for the collection
41	  /// \param path The path where data will be stored
42	  /// \param format The file format for persistence
43	  /// \param max_cache_rows Maximum number of rows to keep in cache
44	  /// \param max_rows Maximum number of rows allowed in the store
45	  MemForwardStore(const std::shared_ptr<CollectionSchema> &collection_schema,
46	                  const std::string &path, const FileFormat format,
47	                  const uint32_t max_buffer_size = 100 * 1024 * 1024);
48	
49	  virtual ~MemForwardStore() {
50	    close();
51	  }
52	
53	  /// Check if the store is full
54	  /// \return true if the store has reached its maximum capacity
55	  bool is_full() {
56	    return total_bytes() >= max_buffer_size_;
57	  }
58	
59	  /// Open the store
60	  /// \return 0 on success, non-zero on failure
61	  Status Open() override;
62	
63	  /// Insert a document into the store
64	  /// \param doc The document to insert
65	  /// \return 0 on success, non-zero on failure
66	  Status insert(const Doc &doc);
67	
68	  /// Flush cached data to disk
69	  /// \return 0 on success, non-zero on failure
70	  Status flush();
71	
72	  /// Close the store and flush any remaining data
73	  /// \return 0 on success, non-zero on failure
74	  Status close();
75	
76	 public:
77	  /// Get the path of the store
78	  /// \return The path where data is stored
79	  const std::string path() const {
80	    return path_;
81	  }
82	
83	  /// Get the total bytes of the store
84	  uint32_t total_bytes() const {
85	    return total_cache_bytes_ + total_rb_bytes_;
86	  }
87	
88	  /// Get the total number of rows in the store
89	  uint32_t num_rows() const {
90	    return num_rows_;
91	  }
92	
93	 public:
94	  /// Fetch specific columns and row indices from the data source
95	  /// \param columns The list of column names to fetch
96	  /// \param indices The list of row indices to fetch
97	  /// \return A table containing the requested data or nullptr on failure
98	  TablePtr fetch(const std::vector<std::string> &columns,
99	                 const std::vector<int> &indices) override;
100	
101	  /// Fetch specific columns and row indices from the data source
102	  /// \param columns The list of column names to fetch
103	  /// \param index The row index to fetch
104	  /// \return An ExecBatch containing the requested data or nullptr on failure
105	  ExecBatchPtr fetch(const std::vector<std::string> &columns,
106	                     int index) override;
107	
108	  /// Scan specified columns from the data source
109	  /// \param columns The list of column names to scan
110	  /// \return A RecordBatchReader for streaming the data or nullptr on failure
111	  RecordBatchReaderPtr scan(const std::vector<std::string> &columns) override;
112	
113	  /// Get the physical schema of the file
114	  /// \return A shared pointer to the arrow schema representing the physical
115	  /// structure of the data
116	  const std::shared_ptr<arrow::Schema> physic_schema() const override {
117	    return physic_schema_;
118	  }
119	
120	  TablePtr get_table() override;
121	
122	 private:
123	  /// Create a RecordBatchBuilder for this store
124	  /// \return A new RecordBatchBuilder
125	  RecordBatchBuilderPtr createBuilder();
126	
127	  /// Convert internal data to a RecordBatch
128	  /// \return A Result containing the RecordBatch or an error status
129	  arrow::Result<RecordBatchPtr> convertToRecordBatch();
130	
131	  /// Convert internal data to a Table
132	  /// \param columns The list of column names to include
133	  /// \param indices The list of row indices to include
134	  /// \return A Result containing the Table or an error status
135	  arrow::Result<TablePtr> convertToTable(
136	      const std::vector<std::string> &columns, const std::vector<int> &indices);
137	
138	  /// Convert internal data to a RecordBatchBuilder
139	  /// \param builder The builder to populate
140	  /// \return arrow::Status indicating success or failure
141	  arrow::Status convertToBuilder(RecordBatchBuilderPtr &builder);
142	
143	  /// Validate that the requested columns exist in the schema
144	  /// \param columns The list of column names to validate
145	  /// \return true if all columns are valid, false otherwise
146	  bool validate(const std::vector<std::string> &columns) const;
147	
148	 private:
149	  /// Mutex to protect cache access
150	  std::mutex cache_mtx_;
151	
152	  /// Cache of documents waiting to be flushed
153	  std::vector<Doc> cache_;
154	
155	  /// Batches of data that have been flushed
156	  std::vector<RecordBatchPtr> batches_;
157	
158	  /// Collection schema
159	  std::shared_ptr<CollectionSchema> schema_;
160	
161	  /// Physical schema
162	  std::shared_ptr<arrow::Schema> physic_schema_;
163	
164	  /// Total RecordBatch bytes in the store
165	  uint32_t total_rb_bytes_{0};
166	
167	  /// Total cache doc bytes
168	  uint32_t total_cache_bytes_{0};
169	
170	  /// Total number of rows in the store
171	  uint32_t num_rows_{0};
172	
173	  /// Path where data is stored
174	  std::string path_;
175	
176	  /// File format for persistence
177	  FileFormat format_;
178	
179	  /// Number of batches that have been flushed
180	  uint32_t flushed_batches_{0};
181	
182	  /// Writer for chunked files
183	  ChunkedFileWriter::Ptr writer_;
184	
185	
186	  /// Maximum size of cache, default 1MB
187	  uint32_t max_cache_size_{1048576};
188	
189	  /// Maximum size of the buffer, default 100MB
190	  uint32_t max_buffer_size_{104857600};
191	};
192	
193	}  // namespace zvec
